task: Memory OS CLI Extensions & Prompt Context Injection
resolution: Extended the main memos.py CLI with search, user-memory, and context commands for unified agent execution. Updated SystemPromptBuilder to query User-OS memories and inject them into the system prompt using a dependency-free YAML formatter while strictly filtering out developer codebase/symbol references.
lessons_learned: Consolidating CLI search and database management under a single entry point simplifies agent interaction, and dependency-free formatters prevent external packaging overhead.

task: Phase 3 Audit Logging & Process Hijacking Fix
hurdles_regression: Importing db_exporter inside unit tests triggers utils.setup_and_run_venv which relaunches the script using a subprocess, causing process hijacking and ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scraper' due to missing root directory in sys.path.
resolution: Mocked scraper.utils.setup_and_run_venv as a no-op at the top of the test suite before importing any routes or db_exporter classes, preventing process hijacking. Completed all audit logging integrations across governance, credentials, briefs, videos, and scraper blueprints, and verified that all 239 unit/integration tests pass.
lessons_learned: When modules execute environment setup code or spawn subprocesses during import, tests must mock those setup helpers at the very beginning of the test execution lifecycle to avoid process hijacking.

task: Updated Global Roadmap with Completed Phase 2 and 3 Items
resolution: Checked off completed Phase 2 Cost & Quota Dashboard, and Phase 3 Evidence & OSINT features (Artifact Store, Timestamp & Hash Verification, Evidence Bundle Export, and Retention Locks) in the global roadmap.
lessons_learned: Keeping the roadmap accurate and up-to-date helps coordinate future developer and agent workstreams.

hurdles_regression: Expected source_id' must be a positive integer error message instead of Watcher 'source_id' is required in test loop check when source_id is missing.
resolution: Created configs/watchers.config.json with primary/secondary watcher configurations. Implemented validate_watcher_config(payload) in governance.py verifying watcher fields, source ID, positive integers, enabled flag, runs per day, cost limits, and crawl interval boundaries (min 15 mins to prevent rate limit overheating). Covered with scratch/test_watchers_config.py unit test.
lessons_learned: Validating configuration limits and crawl intervals before scheduling background watchers ensures runtime safety and avoids unexpected rate-limit exhaustion.

resolution: Implemented execute_watchers(root_dir) in governance.py which parses configs/watchers.config.json, filters enabled watchers, runs validation check, logs runs in connector_runs, and logs watcher.run event in audit_events using the same transaction connection.
